prose: Reuters reports China's CXMT plans to start HBM3E production despite yields of just 20% to 30%, with performance closer to SK Hynix's previous-generation HBM3 than to current HBM3E. The move would give China's AI chip efforts a domestic high-bandwidth memory supply, however imperfect.
highlights: CXMT to start HBM3E production at 20-30% yields
Performance closer to last-gen HBM3 than current HBM3E
A domestic HBM source for China's AI chip program
